summary: Iter 337: 'Jessi hosts your calls' preview fallback backend testing. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_live_host_api_iter337.py with 17 tests covering Test Lab registration/toggle, /call-bridge classic <Gather> fallback with host stamped, /call-bridge-host-after decision branches (go->Dial no <Say>, later->bare Hangup, none+silence/timeout-> <Say> No input received + Hangup, missing decision-> classic <Gather> + skip_reason 'never got on the line', wrong token/unknown pid-> sorry <Say>+<Hangup> never <Dial>), /scripts/roleplay/twiml classic <Gather> announcement + host stamped (English NO_KEY, Dutch 'Dutch' reason, practice sessions untouched), /scripts/roleplay/host-after (go -> ring.wav no 'Here it comes' + gate_via 'host:speech' + gate_passed_at, later manual -> bare <Hangup/> + status unreachable outcome postponed, missing decision -> classic <Gather> + host.skip_reason, wrong token -> 404), and services.mystery_shops.serialize_call surfacing the host object (or None). All 17/17 passed. Regression suite (test_live_host.py, test_live_shops.py, test_live_interview.py, test_shop_call_guards.py) still passes 20/20. Test Lab feature live_host confirmed at status 'live' at end of run (last PUT sets to live and the follow-up GET asserts it).
critical_code_review_comments: call-bridge-host-after returns HTTP 200 with a sorry <Say>+<Hangup/> on wrong token or unknown pid (as spec'd) - never leaks 5xx to Twilio. Good.

shop /host-after returns 404 on wrong token (via _phone_session HTTPException). Twilio will see a 404 - consider whether Twilio should get a safe TwiML fallback instead of 404 for host-after. Spec explicitly requires 404 though, so kept as is.

In call_bridge_twiml, when use_host is True but pending has no token, the else branch stamps host.skip_reason 'pending call without token' - this only fires if a caller inserted an old pending_call without a token. place_click_to_call now sets token, so legacy pending_calls are the only risk; consider a migration or explicit filter.

context_for_next_testing_agent: test_live_host_api_iter337.py is safe to re-run: it cleans its own docs (qa_test / rep_name QA Host) and always leaves live_host flag on 'live'. If OPENAI_API_KEY ever appears in preview, the classic-fallback assertions will start failing since decide() would return use_host=True; guard by unsetting the env before the /call-bridge assertions.
rca of the issue: No issues found - feature works per spec in the no-key preview: every gate falls back to the classic Twilio <Say>/<Gather> path and stamps a host object with transport 'say' + a human-readable skip_reason.
